ditto.obtainedAt: Wild encounters in the Pokémon Mansion on Cinnabar Island.

speciesDetermination.femaleDeterminesSpecies: The female parent determines the offspring's species.
speciesDetermination.withDitto: With a Ditto pair, the non-Ditto parent determines the offspring's species.

eggMoveAcquisition.how: The father must already know the move — catch or hatch a male that has it, then pair him at the Day Care.

eggEfficiencyModifiers.name: Bicycle
eggEfficiencyModifiers.effect: Eggs hatch from steps taken. Covering those same steps on a bicycle takes less real time than walking.
eggEfficiencyModifiers.singleSourceReason: Self-evident in play: a bicycle covers the same step count in less wall-clock time. Not a rate, so a second source is not a measurement.

noEggRateBoostsReason: This game has no item or charm that raises how often eggs appear — Day Care compatibility alone sets the rate.
noEggShinyBoostsReason: The Masuda Method doesn't exist in this game — it was introduced in Generation IV — and the Shiny Charm came later still, in Generation V. Base odds are the only egg shiny odds here.
hatchMechanicExplainer: Leave two compatible Pokémon at the Four Island Day Care (the Route 5 Day Care only holds one, so it cannot produce eggs). After enough steps the Day-Care Man offers an Egg; how often that happens depends only on whether the parents share a species and Original Trainer — there is no Oval Charm or other rate boost here. Carry the Egg in your party and walk: it hatches at level 5. Flame Body does not shorten hatch steps in FireRed/LeafGreen (that starts in Emerald).

moveDescriptions.Dragon Dance: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by one stage each.

abilityDescriptions.Blaze: When this Pokémon's HP is at or below one-third, the power of its Fire-type moves is boosted.
abilityDescriptions.Intimidate: Lowers the Attack of opposing Pokémon when this Pokémon enters battle.

hatchRoutes.method: Eggs hatch from steps taken in the overworld.

featureGates.unlockedAfter: the Elite Four, then Rainbow Pass access to Four Island (deliver the Ruby and Sapphire to Celio on One Island)
